notes: Authoritative source: AJA's own spec sheet PDF (aja.com/products/kumo-3232-12g/spec-sheet.pdf), cross-checked against the product page. The unit is a 2RU frame with 32 physical BNC input connectors and 32 physical BNC output connectors (all identical, auto-sensing up to 12G-SDI) — represented above as one aggregated input port and one aggregated output port rather than 64 near-duplicate entries; label them 1-32 per silkscreen if expanding. The two Reference BNCs form a looping (non-terminating) pair, not separate signal paths — modeled as In/Loop. Power is DC-in only on the chassis (dual redundant 4-pin Molex, 10-14VDC, 24W typical/25.2W max each); the connector list has no exact 4-pin locking DC entry, so "dc-barrel" was used as the closest match for an externally-supplied DC input — the unit ships with a universal 100-240VAC external adapter (60W) that plugs into wall power, with the chassis-side connector being 4-pin Molex, not a coaxial barrel jack. The "USB" port is documented in AJA's own text as "Mini-USB" (not Micro-USB); "usb-micro" was used as the nearest available id since "mini-usb" is not in the provided connector list — this is IP-configuration only, not a data/host port, so no USB grade was set. No HDMI, analog audio, or fiber ports exist on this model (SDI-only router). RS-422 pinout (DB-9 female) is fully documented in the spec sheet if needed. All grade values map correctly to their connector types (sdi-12g on the BNC SDI I/O, eth-1g on the RJ-45 LAN); no grade was set on Ref In/Loop, USB, RS-422, or the DC power ports per instructions.

ports.name: SDI In 1-32
ports.note: 32x BNC inputs; 12G/6G/3G/1.5G/SD-SDI auto-select, SMPTE-259/292/424/2081/2082. Modeled as one representative port; physically 32 discrete BNC connectors labeled 1-32.

ports.name: SDI Out 1-32
ports.note: 32x BNC outputs; 12G/6G/3G/1.5G/SD-SDI auto-select, noninverting. Modeled as one representative port; physically 32 discrete BNC connectors labeled 1-32.

ports.name: Ref In
ports.note: External reference input, looping/non-terminating, accepts blackburst (SD) or tri-level sync (HD). Two BNC connectors form a loop-through pair (Ref In / Ref Loop).

ports.name: Ref Loop
ports.note: Loop-through output of the reference input pair (non-terminating passthrough), not an independent SDI signal path.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 10/100/1000 Ethernet; embedded web server, Bonjour, AJA KUMO control panel support, basic Grass Valley Native Protocol.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Labeled 'USB' on rear panel; physical connector is Mini-USB (5-pin) per spec sheet text, used only for IP address configuration via AJA eMini-Setup. Closest available connector id used since 'mini-usb' is not in the allowed list; no data-rate grade applies (config-only interface).

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: DB-9 female, RS-422 remote control, basic Grass Valley Native Protocol support.

ports.name: PS 1
ports.note: Redundant DC power input 1. Actual connector is a 4-pin locking Molex, 10-14VDC regulated (closest allowed connector id used: dc-barrel; not a true barrel jack). Powered by included external AC-DC adapter (100-240VAC, 50/60Hz, 60W).

ports.name: PS 2
ports.note: Redundant DC power input 2 (identical to PS 1), for the optional second external AC adapter (KUMO-PWR, sold separately).
